Closed as superseded by [PR #41](https://github.com/agent-ix/quire-contract-ir/pull/41), [quire-contract-ir#38](https://github.com/agent-ix/quire-contract-ir/issues/38), and [Engineering Assurance #7](https://github.com/agent-ix/engineering-assurance/issues/7).

The reviewed disposition preserves the repeatability, tamper, failure-propagation, resource-boundary, tool-identity, mutation, and native domain cases as fixture inputs. It rejects the proposed generic executor, central profile, aggregate verdict, authority index, adoption command, parallel result family, and retention component.

Domain repositories continue to own execution and structured results. Quire owns non-executing static export, Quoin owns non-executing explicit intake/retention/audit/reporting, and ix-flow owns attributed human decisions. No migration is authorized by this closure.
